comment: The art coverage report's allowlist (Phase A, the owner's A3): greybox kept on purpose and outside ordinary play, each with its reason.
A fallback named here is counted as allowed; any other fallback is unexpected and counts against the gate line
('UNNAMED art coverage: N requested, N resolved, N fallbacks, N unexpected'). Keys are '<kind>:<id>' as the report lists them;
a key ending in '*' allows every key it begins. Never allow here what a player sees in ordinary play.

allowed.debug:*: the F3 debug overlay's markers, drawn only while a developer has the overlay on; never shown in normal play (charter §3: no markers)
